title: UBHAR Programme
description: Junior-to-senior transition and academy strengthening for Olympic and Para sports, supported by Tata Trusts.
lede: Junior-to-senior transition and academy strengthening for Olympic and Para sports, supported by Tata Trusts.

paragraphs: The UBHAR Programme is focused on strengthening India's high-performance sports ecosystem by supporting young athletes as they transition from junior to senior competition, with structured, long-term support across training, sports science, and competition exposure.

Alongside athlete development, UBHAR works closely with academies to strengthen infrastructure, systems, and institutional capacity across sports including boxing, gymnastics, kho kho, kabaddi, archery, and athletics.

In FY 2025–26, from over 650 athlete applications, 13 athletes were selected across international, national, and state levels, while two academies — Bhoir Gymkhana and Eklavya Krida Mandal — were onboarded after detailed due diligence.

story.name: Bhoir Gymkhana
paragraphs: The story: A high-performance gymnastics academy seeking a transparent, structured way to formalise its athlete development systems.
The GSF impact: UBHAR's rigorous, data-driven selection and onboarding process assessed the academy's background, performance, and systems in detail.
The result: Onboarding gave the academy's athletes more visibility, organised support, and a chance to compete at a higher level.

items.quote: “We were confident in the system because the selection process was transparent and well-organized, particularly the thorough assessment of the academy's background and performance.”
items.name: Pawan Bhoir
items.role: Owner & High Performance Coach, Bhoir Gymkhana

items.quote: “Coming from a Tier 3–4 setup where such structured support is rare, the selection process made us reflect deeply on our 27 years of on-ground work and systems.”
items.name: Nirmalchandra Thorat
